correctness.rationale: For n>=3 with nonnegative independent edge conductances, fixed positive P,Q,B, the graph is connected at finite optimum and restricted Laplacian trace inverse is strictly convex in the edge weights since distinct edges give distinct off-diagonal entries. Uniqueness plus prism automorphisms forces common ring x_n>0 and rung y_n>0. Symmetric/antisymmetric Fourier modes give T=n(2P+Qt)/B*(a_n+sum_{k=0}^{n-1}1/(mu_k+2t)) and the stated unique scalar stationary equation. Exact cycle resolvent F_n(t)=n/(2sqrt(t(t+2)))*(1+rho(t)^n)/(1-rho(t)^n); testing t=s n^(-2/3), compactness upper/lower bounds on optimal s, uniform convergence yield minimizer s*=(18P^2/Q^2)^(1/3), t_n~s*n^(-2/3), T=(P/(6B))n^3+(Q*s/(4B))n^(7/3)+o(n^(7/3)). The n^5/3 rung scaling and equal-price 2/3 comparison follow. Independent full Laplacian traces n=3..7 and asymptotic n=200,400,800 checks corroborate, not replace proof.
